Export Plots to Files

Source: R/help_plot.R
dot-export_plot_output.Rd

Exports one or more ggplot objects to PNG and/or PDF files. Supports exporting to separate files or creating a single merged PDF with multiple pages.

Usage

.export_plot_output(
  plots,
  output_path = NULL,
  export_picture = TRUE,
  export_as_pdf = FALSE,
  export_config = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  panel_layout = NULL
)

Arguments

plots

A ggplot object or a list of ggplot objects to export.

output_path

Character. Directory where the plots will be saved. Default is current working directory.

export_picture

Logical. If TRUE, exports the plots as PNG files. Default is TRUE.

export_as_pdf

Logical or character. If TRUE, exports the plots as PDF files. If "merged", creates a single multi-page PDF. Default is FALSE.

export_config

List. Configuration parameters for export:

  • width: Plot width in inches.

  • height: Plot height in inches.

  • dpi: Resolution for PNG export (default: 300).

  • bg: Background color (default: "white").

  • limitsize: Whether to limit size (default: FALSE).

  • file_name: Base name for exported files (default: "gtap_plots").

data

A data frame used for automatic dimension calculation if not specified in export_config.

panel_layout

A list with 'rows' and 'cols' for automatic dimension calculation.

Value

Invisibly returns the input plots.

See also

comparison_plot, detail_plot, stack_plot
